S22.28.needs: a signed-in account and a working model (the code does not say which account type is required); a folder where the agent may write
S22.28.note: The overlay is shown only when the agent needs permission for a tool call; whether a given request triggers it depends on the permission mode, which I did not trace (/permissions is the command that sets it, in apps/cli/src/repl/slash_commands.rs).
steps: Type a request that needs a file change or a command, for example: create a file called test.txt in the current folder
When the "Tool Approval" box appears, read the question and the file or command listed above the buttons
Check the buttons shown: " Yes ", " No ", " Allow Session ", " Always allow ", " Deny All " and " Allow All "; hover the text of each by moving with the arrow keys to read its description

Press n or Esc to refuse, or y to allow once, and check that the box closes and the agent continues or stops as chosen (compare with Expected: what will happen is shown, and approve or deny is offered)
S22.28.where: agi (run in Terminal; the full-screen TUI opens by default unless --no-tui is passed) > type a request that makes the agent run a shell command or change a file > the "Tool Approval" box

S22.29.needs: an MCP server that requests structured input (the code does not name one); a signed-in account
S22.29.note: The form is driven by an MCP server, not by the assistant itself, so the tester needs a server that sends this request; the assistant-only path I did not find. The /mcp command is in apps/cli/src/repl/slash_commands.rs and I did not verify which server the tester should use.
steps: Connect an MCP server whose tool asks for structured input (for example one that asks for a token and a scope); add it with the /mcp command
Run agi and ask the agent to use that server's tool
When the "MCP Request: <server name>" box appears, read the message at the top and the fields below it
Fill the fields with the arrow keys and Tab, then press Enter on Accept to send the answer
Compare with Expected: the questions appear as an inline form with fields and options, and the answer goes back to the agent. Press Esc to cancel and check the box closes
S22.29.where: agi (TUI) > a connected MCP server sends a request for input > the "MCP Request: <server name>" box with Accept, Decline and Cancel

S22.30.needs: a signed-in account and a working model (the table depends on the model writing a markdown table)
S22.30.note: The table is drawn by the markdown renderer (apps/cli/src/tui/markdown_renderer.rs, render_table) for any assistant answer, so it appears only if the model writes a table; the tui_app.rs:1530 line cited in Code no longer holds the quoted code, and the answer-drawing calls are at apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:2923 and 2970. No decision-specific path was found.
steps: Run agi and ask a question that compares options, for example: compare three database options in a table
When the answer appears, look for a bordered table with a styled header row and a divider line under the header
Check that the columns line up and that each option's values sit in the same column (compare with Expected: a readable comparison table)
S22.30.where: Shown inside the assistant's answer in agi (TUI) when the answer contains a markdown table; no control of its own
